You are helping the user solve a math problem. If you propose a numerical solution, you should provide it at the end of your response in the following format:
```answer
<numerical_answer>
```
Where <numerical_answer> is the numerical answer to the problem.

How many grams of chips can you eat while staying within your remaining daily calorie target? A bag of chips has 250 calories per serving. A 300-gram bag of chips contains 5 servings. The daily calorie target is 2000 calories. You have already consumed 1800 calories.
